question: List all networks with their ID, name, tenant ID, status, MTU, administrative state, and VLAN transparency flag, ordered by tenant ID and network name.
gold_sql: SELECT id, name, tenant_id, status, mtu, admin_state_up, vlan_transparent FROM networks ORDER BY tenant_id, name, id;
pred_sql:
SELECT 
    id AS network_id,
    name AS network_name,
    tenant_id,
    status,
    mtu,
    admin_state_up,
    vlan_transparent
FROM 
    networks
ORDER BY 
    tenant_id, 
    name;

question: Show the number of networks by status and administrative state, ordered from the largest count to the smallest.
gold_sql: SELECT status, admin_state_up, COUNT(*) AS network_count FROM networks GROUP BY status, admin_state_up ORDER BY network_count DESC;
pred_sql:
SELECT 
    status, 
    admin_state_up, 
    COUNT(*) AS network_count
FROM 
    networks
GROUP BY 
    status, 
    admin_state_up
ORDER BY 
    network_count DESC;

question: For each tenant, show the number of networks, minimum MTU, maximum MTU, and average MTU. Include only tenants with at least two networks.
gold_sql: SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS network_count, MIN(mtu) AS min_mtu, MAX(mtu) AS max_mtu, AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM networks GROUP BY tenant_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY network_count DESC;
pred_sql:
SELECT 
    tenant_id,
    COUNT(id) AS network_count,
    MIN(mtu) AS min_mtu,
    MAX(mtu) AS max_mtu,
    AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu
FROM 
    networks
GROUP BY 
    tenant_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(id) >= 2;

question: For each network, show the network name, status, number of ports, and number of distinct device owners, including networks with no ports.
gold_sql: SELECT n.id AS network_id, n.name AS network_name, n.status, COUNT(p.id) AS port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.device_owner) AS distinct_device_owner_count FROM networks n LEFT JOIN ports p ON p.network_id = n.id GROUP BY n.id, n.name, n.status ORDER BY port_count DESC;

    n.status AS network_status,
    COUNT(p.id) AS port_count,

question: For each network, show the number of subnets, number of DHCP-enabled subnets, and number of distinct IP versions.
gold_sql: SELECT n.id AS network_id, n.name AS network_name, COUNT(s.id) AS subnet_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.enable_dhcp = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dhcp_enabled_subnet_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ip_version) AS ip_version_count FROM networks n LEFT JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id GROUP BY n.id, n.name ORDER BY subnet_count DESC;

    n.id AS network_id,

    SUM(s.enable_dhcp) AS dhcp_enabled_subnets,

question: List subnets with their network name, CIDR, gateway IP, first allocation pool IP, and last allocation pool IP.
gold_sql: SELECT s.id AS subnet_id, s.name AS subnet_name, n.name AS network_name, s.cidr, s.gateway_ip, p.first_ip, p.last_ip FROM subnets s JOIN networks n ON n.id = s.network_id LEFT JOIN ipallocationpools p ON p.subnet_id = s.id ORDER BY n.name, s.cidr;

    s.id AS subnet_id,
    n.name AS network_name,
    s.cidr,
    s.gateway_ip,
    ipr.first_ip AS first_allocation_pool_ip,
    ipr.last_ip AS last_allocation_pool_ip

    subnets AS s

    networks AS n ON s.network_id = n.id

question: For each subnet, show the CIDR, number of allocated IP addresses, number of DNS nameservers, and number of host routes.
gold_sql: SELECT s.id AS subnet_id, s.cidr, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.ip_address) AS allocated_ip_count, COUNT(DISTINCT dns.address) AS dns_nameserver_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.destination) AS host_route_count FROM subnets s LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.subnet_id = s.id LEFT JOIN dnsnameservers dns ON dns.subnet_id = s.id LEFT JOIN subnetroutes sr ON sr.subnet_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.cidr ORDER BY allocated_ip_count DESC;
pred_sql:
SELECT 
    s.id AS subnet_id,
    s.cidr,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ia.ip_address) AS allocated_ip_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dn.address) AS dns_nameserver_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sr.destination) AS host_route_count
FROM 
    subnets AS s
LEFT JOIN 
    ipallocations AS ia ON s.id = ia.subnet_id
LEFT JOIN 
    dnsnameservers AS dn ON s.id = dn.subnet_id
LEFT JOIN 
    subnetroutes AS sr ON s.id = sr.subnet_id
GROUP BY 
    s.id, s.cidr;

question: For each port, show the port name, network name, MAC address, number of allocated IPs, and whether port security is enabled.
gold_sql: SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.name AS port_name, n.name AS network_name, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS allocated_ip_count, ps.port_security_enabled FROM ports p JOIN networks n ON n.id = p.network_id LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN portsecuritybindings ps ON ps.port_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name, n.name, p.mac_address, ps.port_security_enabled ORDER BY allocated_ip_count DESC;
pred_sql:
SELECT 
    p.name AS port_name,
    n.name AS network_name,
    p.mac_address,
    COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS allocated_ips,
    psb.port_security_enabled
FROM 
    ports AS p
LEFT JOIN 
    networks AS n ON p.network_id = n.id
LEFT JOIN 
    ipallocations AS ia ON p.id = ia.port_id
LEFT JOIN 
    portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id
GROUP BY 
    p.id, p.name, n.name, p.mac_address, psb.port_security_enabled;

question: Find ports with more than one allocated IP address and show the port, network, device owner, and allocated IP count.
gold_sql: SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.name AS port_name, n.name AS network_name, p.device_owner, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS allocated_ip_count FROM ports p JOIN networks n ON n.id = p.network_id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name, n.name, p.device_owner HAVING COUNT(ia.ip_address) > 1 ORDER BY allocated_ip_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.id AS port_id, 
    p.network_id, 
    p.device_owner, 
    COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS allocated_ip_count
FROM 
    ports AS p
JOIN 
    ipallocations AS ia ON p.id = ia.port_id
GROUP BY 
    p.id, p.network_id, p.device_owner
HAVING 
    COUNT(ia.ip_address) > 1;

question: For each router, show its name, status, gateway port status, gateway network name, and SNAT setting, including routers without a gateway port.
gold_sql: SELECT r.id AS router_id, r.name AS router_name, r.status AS router_status, p.status AS gateway_port_status, n.name AS gateway_network_name, r.enable_snat FROM routers r LEFT JOIN ports p ON p.id = r.gw_port_id LEFT JOIN networks n ON n.id = p.network_id ORDER BY r.tenant_id, r.name;

    r.name AS router_name,
    r.status AS router_status,
    p.status AS gateway_port_status,
    n.name AS gateway_network_name,

FROM 
    routers AS r

    ports AS p ON r.gw_port_id = p.id

    networks AS n ON p.network_id = n.id;

question: For each router and router port type, show attached port count and number of distinct networks reached through those ports.

    rp.port_type,

question: For each router, show attached port count, floating IP count, and distinct fixed port count used by floating IPs.

question: List floating IPs with floating network name, fixed port name, fixed IP address, router name, and status.
gold_sql: SELECT f.id AS floating_ip_id, f.floating_ip_address, fn.name AS floating_network_name, fp.name AS fixed_port_name, f.fixed_ip_address, r.name AS router_name, f.status FROM floatingips f LEFT JOIN networks fn ON fn.id = f.floating_network_id LEFT JOIN ports fp ON fp.id = f.fixed_port_id LEFT JOIN routers r ON r.id = f.router_id ORDER BY f.status, f.floating_ip_address;

    f.floating_ip_address AS floating_ip,
    n.name AS floating_network_name,
    p.name AS fixed_port_name,

    f.status AS status

    floatingips AS f

    networks AS n ON f.floating_network_id = n.id

    ports AS p ON f.fixed_port_id = p.id
JOIN 
    routers AS r ON f.router_id = r.id;

question: For each security group, show rule count, ingress rule count, egress rule count, and number of ports bound to the group.
gold_sql: SELECT sg.id AS security_group_id, sg.name AS security_group_name, sg.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sgr.id) AS rule_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sgr.direction = 'ingress' THEN sgr.id END) AS ingress_rule_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sgr.direction = 'egress' THEN sgr.id END) AS egress_rule_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sgb.port_id) AS bound_port_count FROM securitygroups sg LEFT JOIN securitygrouprules sgr ON sgr.security_group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb ON sgb.security_group_id = sg.id GROUP BY sg.id, sg.name, sg.tenant_id ORDER BY rule_count DESC;
pred_sql:
SELECT 
    sg.id AS security_group_id,
    sg.name AS security_group_name,
    COUNT(sgr.id) AS total_rule_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sgr.direction = 'ingress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ingress_rule_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sgr.direction = 'egress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS egress_rule_count,
    COUNT(sgp.port_id) AS bound_port_count
FROM 
    securitygroups AS sg
LEFT JOIN 
    securitygrouprules AS sgr ON sg.id = sgr.security_group_id
LEFT JOIN 
    securitygroupportbindings AS sgp ON sg.id = sgp.security_group_id
GROUP BY 
    sg.id, sg.name;

question: Find ports assigned to more than one security group and show their network, device owner, and security group count.
gold_sql: SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.name AS port_name, n.name AS network_name, p.device_owner, COUNT(sgb.security_group_id) AS security_group_count FROM ports p JOIN networks n ON n.id = p.network_id JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb ON sgb.port_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name, n.name, p.device_owner HAVING COUNT(sgb.security_group_id) > 1 ORDER BY security_group_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.network_id,
    p.device_owner,
    COUNT(sgp.security_group_id) AS security_group_count
FROM 
    ports AS p
JOIN 
    securitygroupportbindings AS sgp
ON 
    p.id = sgp.port_id
GROUP BY 
    p.id, p.network_id, p.device_owner
HAVING 
    COUNT(sgp.security_group_id) > 1;

question: For each network, show total security group assignments across its ports and the number of distinct security groups used.

question: For each network, show its ML2 network type, physical network, segmentation ID, and whether the network is external.
gold_sql: SELECT n.id AS network_id, n.name AS network_name, seg.network_type, seg.physical_network, seg.segmentation_id, ex.is_default AS is_default_external_network FROM networks n LEFT JOIN ml2_network_segments seg ON seg.network_id = n.id LEFT JOIN externalnetworks ex ON ex.network_id = n.id ORDER BY n.name, seg.segment_index;
pred_sql:
SELECT 
    n.id AS network_id,
    n.name AS network_name,
    mns.network_type,
    mns.physical_network,
    mns.segmentation_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN en.network_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_external
FROM 
    networks AS n
LEFT JOIN 
    ml2_network_segments AS mns ON n.id = mns.network_id
LEFT JOIN 
    externalnetworks AS en ON n.id = en.network_id;

question: For each host and VIF type, show the number of bound ports and the number of distinct networks those ports belong to.

question: For each DHCP agent host, show the number of bound networks and the number of distinct tenants owning those networks.
gold_sql: SELECT a.host, COUNT(DISTINCT nb.network_id) AS bound_network_count, COUNT(DISTINCT n.tenant_id) AS distinct_tenant_count FROM networkdhcpagentbindings nb JOIN agents a ON a.id = nb.dhcp_agent_id JOIN networks n ON n.id = nb.network_id GROUP BY a.host ORDER BY bound_network_count DESC;

question: For each tenant, show network count, port count, subnet count, router count, and floating IP count in one row.
gold_sql: WITH tenant_networks AS (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS network_count FROM networks GROUP BY tenant_id), tenant_ports AS (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS port_count FROM ports GROUP BY tenant_id), tenant_subnets AS (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS subnet_count FROM subnets GROUP BY tenant_id), tenant_routers AS (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS router_count FROM routers GROUP BY tenant_id), tenant_fips AS (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS floating_ip_count FROM floatingips GROUP BY tenant_id) SELECT tn.tenant_id, tn.network_count, COALESCE(tp.port_count, 0) AS port_count, COALESCE(ts.subnet_count, 0) AS subnet_count, COALESCE(tr.router_count, 0) AS router_count, COALESCE(tf.floating_ip_count, 0) AS floating_ip_count FROM tenant_networks tn LEFT JOIN tenant_ports tp ON tp.tenant_id = tn.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tenant_subnets ts ON ts.tenant_id = tn.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tenant_routers tr ON tr.tenant_id = tn.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tenant_fips tf ON tf.tenant_id = tn.tenant_id ORDER BY tn.network_count DESC;
pred_sql:
SELECT 
    tenant_id,
    SUM(network_count) AS network_count,
    SUM(port_count) AS port_count,
    SUM(subnet_count) AS subnet_count,
    SUM(router_count) AS router_count,
    SUM(floating_ip_count) AS floating_ip_count
FROM (
    SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(id) AS network_count, 0 AS port_count, 0 AS subnet_count, 0 AS router_count, 0 AS floating_ip_count
    FROM networks
    GROUP BY tenant_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT tenant_id, 0 AS network_count, COUNT(id) AS port_count, 0 AS subnet_count, 0 AS router_count, 0 AS floating_ip_count
    FROM ports
    GROUP BY tenant_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT tenant_id, 0 AS network_count, 0 AS port_count, COUNT(id) AS subnet_count, 0 AS router_count, 0 AS floating_ip_count
    FROM subnets
    GROUP BY tenant_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT tenant_id, 0 AS network_count, 0 AS port_count, 0 AS subnet_count, COUNT(id) AS router_count, 0 AS floating_ip_count
    FROM routers
    GROUP BY tenant_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT tenant_id, 0 AS network_count, 0 AS port_count, 0 AS subnet_count, 0 AS router_count, COUNT(id) AS floating_ip_count
    FROM floatingips
    GROUP BY tenant_id
) AS combined_counts
GROUP BY tenant_id;

    q.tenant_id,

ON 
    q.tenant_id = qu.tenant_id AND q.resource = qu.resource
WHERE 
    q.limit > 0;
